Armour rule: The save above. **Boosted (1 Energy, when hit): Brace.** A passed save also stops Press, and any knock to the ground, from that hit
The save above, basic only. **Unreliable:** a kept total of 3 or less on the save jams the armour, which gives no save until a Use action clears it (Routine Tech). A total of exactly 2 is a bodge
The save and Brace without Energy, after a know-how test (Weirdness 6) the first time it is used in a battle: a success means it works all battle, a failure rolls the weird table
